text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, The Japanese Oaks was today, and the Snow Angel boom wasn't showing any signs of stopping. I remember thinking, "I gotta show 'em I'm serious!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Do you remember that other racer I told you about? Everyone seemed to have such high hopes for her, and I think it was making me all kinds of jealous.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I can't really explain why, but I felt like if I could beat her, maybe things would change. So I headed into the race, ready to snatch the gold!
